quality_rows.rationale: Every alignment tranche must preserve executable regression and TIED integrity.
quality_rows.evidence_method: Manifest command bundle: tsc, vitest, vocabulary, tied_validate_consistency, binding_inventory_validate, traceability_gap_report
quality_rows.threshold: All required commands exit 0; structural validators pass or document approved exceptions.
quality_rows.limitation: Structural and executable checks do not prove unrelated security, performance, privacy, or usability properties.

quality_rows.rationale: Mesh API and files API accept external JSON/path input; covered by vitest-full suite.
quality_rows.evidence_method: Route-level composition tests in Vitest suite (vitest-full manifest command)
quality_rows.threshold: Malformed input and auth rejection tests pass in Vitest route composition suite.
quality_rows.limitation: Does not prove full abuse-case coverage or production deployment hardening.

quality_rows.rationale: Workspace panes, toolbar, and linked navigation are user-facing; partial via component tests and e2e_only inventory rows.
quality_rows.evidence_method: Component/contract tests in vitest-full; browser seams e2e_only in binding inventory
quality_rows.threshold: Component tests pass; e2e_only_reason names browser/Playwright constraint for UI-only bindings.
quality_rows.limitation: Vitest jsdom does not prove visual accessibility or real browser focus order.

quality_rows.rationale: Mesh snapshot save/restore and workspace bridge bindings affect persisted workspace state.
quality_rows.evidence_method: Domain validation and workspace snapshot tests in vitest-full
quality_rows.threshold: Snapshot round-trip and domain validation composition tests pass.
quality_rows.limitation: Does not prove live filesystem mesh depot sync or concurrent mutation safety.
